TC-22/S25.title: Task prompts vs Vikram's p72: system.md word for word (with his exclusion of conditional and monitoring orders); two prototype sentences dropped from the other prompts
TC-22/S25.detail: Static review on 43c38a4f (prompt files byte-identical to e02167f). tasks/system.md equals the decoded p72 TASK_SYSTEM_PROMPT (2,477 characters), including 'EVERYTHING ELSE IS NOT A TASK: monitoring/trending instructions, … future conditional considerations' and the four-category enum (consult, medication, imaging, labs). encounter-review.md lacks 'A bare "continue [medication]" is STATUS, not a task — never create a task for it.' (p72 line 7273) and post-note.md lacks 'A bare continuation ("continue X", "will continue to follow") is STATUS, not a task …' (p72 lines 7690, 7859). Against TFA-92592 AC 13 (prompt unchanged except approved changes): the two dropped sentences are unapproved changes, and no approved change lets AC 3's conditional and monitoring orders through the whitelist (D4, now answered by AC 3). T3's TFA-94229 part is todo.
TC-22/S25.productIssue: The task prompts still tell the model that conditional and monitoring orders are not tasks, contrary to TFA-92592 AC 3; two of Vikram's 'continue X is a status' sentences are missing.
